subject: general
question: Which country will host the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2023?

options.text: United States of America and Canada

solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia and New Zealand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• New Zealand and Australia will host the 2023 FIFA Women’s World Cup.
 
• FIFA announced its decision after its governing council held a vote by videoconference.
 
• The joint bid submitted by Football Federation Australia and New Zealand Football received 22 of the 35 valid votes cast by the FIFA Council members, with the Colombian Football Association having obtained 13 votes.
 
• FIFA’s decision means South America is still waiting to host its first Women’s World Cup, a tournament that was first played in 1991.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• FIFA is a non-profit organization that describes itself as an international governing body of association football, fútsal, and beach soccer.

 
 
• It is the highest governing body of association football. 
 
 
 
• Headquarters: Zürich, Switzerland
 
• Founded: 21 May 1904, Rue Saint-Honoré, Paris, France
 
• Main organ: FIFA Congress
